data.title: Shinkansen bullet trains remain halted after M7.1 quake hits Kumamoto
data.description: Services on the Kyushu Shinkansen bullet train line will remain halted Wednesday, its operator said, a day after an earthquake with a magnitude of 7.1 struck the southwestern Japan prefecture of Kumamoto.

data.title: Netanyahu holds first White House talks with Trump since Iran war began
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited the White House Tuesday for his first in-person talks with President Donald Trump since the Iran war began, as the US military reported it had intercepted multiple missiles launched by Tehran.

data.title: US government bans humanoid robots manufactured abroad
data.description: NEW YORK - US President Donald Trump's administration on Tuesday added humanoid and quadruped robots to a list of products and companies that are banned from being imported into the United States on national security grounds.

data.title: Airbus completes record 24-hour flight with plane to be used by Qantas
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - A specially modified Airbus A350 plane touched down in France Tuesday after a record 24-hour test flight from Australia, ahead of it joining Qantas's fleet next year.

data.title: Eseme, Hobbs shine in Glasgow rain to win 100m Commonwealth gold
data.description: GLASGOW - Cameroon's Emmanuel Eseme defied the torrential rain in Glasgow to win the men's 100 metres in a Commonwealth Games record time on Tuesday as New Zealand's Zoe Hobbs surged to a surprise victory in the women's 100m.

data.title: 2 dead at quake-hit Kumamoto Pref. shopping mall after blast
data.description: Two women were confirmed dead and one woman was found unresponsive, local authorities said Wednesday, hours after an explosion rocked a shopping mall on Japan's southwestern main island of Kyushu following a powerful magnitude-7.1 earthquake.

data.title: Welfare card recheck deadline nears
data.description: The government has urged those who did not meet the criteria for the state welfare card programme to review their eligibility and related personal data before Friday.

data.title: Senate eligibility row sparks legal threat
data.description: Senator Somphan Palasak on Tuesday threatened legal action against iLaw director Yingcheep Atchanont over allegations that he was ineligible to contest the Senate election under the business owner category.

data.title: Minister vows to build lifelong learning ecosystem
data.description: Thailand's human resources will be driven under the flagship "Thailand2" policy to create a lifelong learning ecosystem and enhance the capabilities of Thai people to align with future global changes, said Minister of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation (MHESI) Yodchanan Wongsawat.

data.title: 7m visit in H1, B263bn in Phuket revenue
data.description: Phuket generated 263 billion baht in tourism revenue during the first six months of this year, attracting nearly seven million visitors, according to the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT).

data.title: PM pledges full investigation into exam rigging
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Tuesday pledged to pursue an investigation into alleged corruption in local government recruitment exams until the end.

data.title: Govt backs paperless e-Office
data.description: The government has backed the Education Ministry's plan to introduce a fully paperless e-Office system across all agencies from Jan 1, 2027, as part of its drive to modernise Thailand's public administration through digital technology.

data.title: Thais will rule Asean, claims former captain
data.description: Theerathon Bunmathan believes Thailand possess the quality to win the Asean Hyundai Cup this year, even after their opening victory over Laos was tougher than many expected.

data.title: FIFA says it hopes to sell $4.2bn stake in its tournaments
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA said Tuesday it plans to sell a stake in the business operations of the World Cup and its other competitions through the creation of a semi-private subsidiary.

data.title: Fires in Europe: latest developments
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Here are the main developments related to the wildfires raging in Spain and France on Tuesday.

data.title: Police seek second suspect over Narathiwat attack
data.description: Police are gathering evidence to seek an arrest warrant for a second suspect believed to have been involved in an attack on a security checkpoint in Narathiwat last week that killed five rangers and injured six civilians.

data.title: Deadly raid puts peace talks on hold
data.description: Peace talks between the government and southern insurgent representatives have been postponed indefinitely following the deadly Narathiwat attack that killed five rangers.

data.title: Interior faces graft clean-up
data.description: Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Tuesday called on senior Interior Ministry officials to turn recent corruption scandals into an opportunity to rebuild public confidence.

data.title: 'No money lost' following TSD portal leak
data.description: No financial losses have been detected after personal information belonging to about 200,000 investors was accessed without authorisation through Thailand Securities Depository Co Ltd's (TSD) Investor Portal website, the Stock Exchange of Thailand's (SET) subsidiary said on Tuesday.

data.title: Vocational gap threatens AI drive
data.description: Thailand's education system may be rapidly embracing artificial intelligence, with millions of students already using AI-assisted learning and almost all teachers under the Office of the Basic Education Commission (Obec) trained to integrate the technology into classrooms.

data.title: 'We're no suicide squad': iLaw director
data.description: As the political storm over the Senate election collusion case intensifies, Internet Law Reform Dialogue (iLaw) has come under renewed scrutiny after naming several senior politicians in connection with the controversy, prompting threats of legal action.

data.title: Five Indians arrested for kidnapping compatriots for ransom in Pattaya
data.description: Police arrested five Indian men in Bangkok on Tuesday for allegedly kidnapping three compatriots for ransom in Pattaya.

data.title: Dry Wave Cocktail Studio is the Best Bar in Thailand
data.description: MACAU — Bangkok isn’t short of drinking holes with eight bars making the Asia’s 50 Best Bars 2026 list at this evening’s awards, held at Wynn Palace.

data.title: Thai FDA, Poland’s URPL advance landmark regulatory pact
data.description: Thailand’s Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and Poland’s Office for Registration of Medicinal Products (URPL) are advancing plans to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to strengthen cooperation in health product regulation, knowledge exchange, and capacity building between the two agencies.

data.title: Dozens feared trapped in quake-hit Japan mall
data.description: TOKYO - Dozens of people were feared trapped in a shopping mall in Japan on Tuesday after a major earthquake toppled buildings, sparked fires and reportedly killed one person and injured more than 100.

data.title: Family seeks help to find Thai YouTuber missing in Georgia
data.description: The family of YouTuber Hlun Solo has appealed for help after he went missing while travelling alone in Georgia to film content, with no contact made for the past two weeks.

data.title: Malaysia busts scam centres in Forest City
data.description: KUALA ​LUMPUR - Malaysian police have raided 32 premises hosting online ​scam activities in Forest ‌City in the state of Johor, arresting 335 people and seizing assets worth about 1 million ringgit ($245,000), the state police chief said on Tuesday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Johan Ghazali promises ‘beast is coming’ after heated Ramadan Ondash face-off
data.description: Johan Ghazali has promised to ride the wave created in Malaysia by Aliff Sor Dechapan’s historic ONE Championship title triumph – and unleash “the beast” against Ramadan Ondash in Friday’s Inner Circle 24 co-main event.

data.title: Anutin brushes off Bhumjaithai rift talk
data.description: Prime Minister and Bhumjaithai Party leader Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed speculation about divisions among the party’s key figures, insisting there are no conflicts within the party and no need for reconciliation talks.

data.title: Thailand steps up Japan drug smuggling probe
data.description: Thai authorities are continuing to coordinate with their Japanese counterparts over the case of a 28-year-old Thai woman arrested at Fukuoka Airport after crystal methamphetamine was found hidden in coffee sachets she was carrying into Japan.

data.title: France turns to Zidane to bring football glory
data.description: PARIS - ​Zinedine Zidane will take charge of France with ‌the weight of history behind him and one of world football’s most gifted squads in front of him, as the 1998 World Cup hero returns to the national team tasked with turning recent near-misses into trophies.

data.title: Firefighters on the offensive in France and Spain
data.description: LEGE-CAP-FERRET, France - Firefighters in France and Spain rushed to contain the worst wildfires in living memory on Tuesday, seizing crucial hours before the arrival of another wave brings scorching temperatures.

data.title: Social Security board election ‘not postponed’
data.description: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has insisted that the election for the Social Security Office (SSO) board has not been postponed, but only temporarily halted after the Supreme Administrative Court issued an injunction, which the SSO plans to appeal.

data.title: 7.1 earthquake strikes Japan’s Kyushu region
data.description: TOKYO - An earthquake with a ​preliminary magnitude of 7.1 struck Kumamoto prefecture in southern Japan on Tuesday, knocking out power to thousands of homes, stopping rail services and triggering warnings for tsunamis and aftershocks.

data.title: PM says Senate case no threat to coalition
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed concerns that allegations of collusion in the Senate election could undermine the coalition government’s stability.

data.title: Thailand Cuts Botulism Drug Cost by 90% in Major Medical Breakthrough
data.description: A non-profit Thai scientific coalition has developed a local botulism antitoxin, slashing treatment costs and positioning the nation as a regional hub

data.title: Former bank manager held after two slain in land dispute
data.description: A former bank manager has been arrested after shooting five relatives, killing two and injuring three, in a long-running dispute over an access road in Bang Bua Thong district of Nonthaburi on Tuesday.
